in_sanskrit.name: Lingesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Linga (symbol) + Ish (God)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lingesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Lingesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Linga' and 'Ish'. Linga refers to a symbol or a representation of a deity, while Ish stands for the divine consciousness or God. Thus, Lingesh can be interpreted as the embodiment or manifestation of God in a symbolic form.
